![ASRock](https://tpucdn.com/images/news/asrock-v1795442328.png)
ASRock, the global leading manufacturer of motherboards, graphics cards, mini PCs, gaming monitors, power supply units, and AIO liquid coolers, today announced the launch of the Taichi AQUA 360 LCD, the flagship all-in-one CPU liquid cooler for builders who want the convenience of an AIO and the freedom to customize their own cooling loop. Inspired by the ASRock Taichi philosophy of infinite potential, this white-and-silver design pairs an illuminated, transparent water channel with a redundant dual-pump architecture and an expandable loop.
A Window into the Cooling Loop
At the center of the Taichi AQUA 360 LCD, ARGB lighting traces the coolant path through the transparent channel of the aluminium water block. Coolant turns the impeller of the built-in flow indicator, so users can see at a glance that coolant is circulating.
![](https://tpucdn.com/img/5dfFk99ziPJfwnSV_thm.jpg)
![](https://tpucdn.com/img/cpkbCGsHKUmQGOLO_thm.jpg)
![](https://tpucdn.com/img/HDtKYSgkHQO026WY_thm.jpg)
The dual-mode top cover allows users to showcase the transparent water channel or snap the magnetic 3.4-inch LCD directly on the water block. The display can also be magnetically attached to the chassis or placed on a desk using the included display stand. ASRock Polychrome DISPLAY software allows users to customize the screen with real-time system information, images, or animated GIFs.
The Taichi AQUA 360 LCD features a redundant dual-pump architecture with a 38 mm-thick, high-density radiator. If one pump stops, the other keeps coolant circulating, and the included buzzer module alerts the user. With both pumps running, the system delivers 2× the coolant flow rate. Integrated G1/4-inch expansion ports give enthusiasts the freedom to customize and extend the cooling loop to suit their own builds.
